title: The Narrow Road to the Deep North and Other Travel Sketches (Oku no Hosomichi)

publication.edition: Penguin Classics; original haibun composed after the 1689 journey

verification.verification_notes: Confirmed Basho's authorship, the 1689 journey (with companion Kawai Sora), the haibun form of prose and haiku, and the Yuasa Penguin Classics 1966 translation with ISBN. Companionable travel-narration technique described, no text reproduced.

limitations: Haibun rhythm, seasonal kigo and allusion depend on Japanese prosody and cannot be fully recovered in English; warmth is partly carried by untranslatable register.

copyright.notes: Penguin Classics translation copyrighted; analytical citation only, no text reproduced.
